step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays New Relic Synthetic testing workflow. At the top row, a user/developer submits test configurations to the Scheduler (EC2). The Scheduler places execution tasks into the Job Queue (SQS). Jobs flow into the Monitor API (EC2) and then to the Results Queue (SQS), which loops results back to the Scheduler. From the Job Queue, tasks are executed by Public Monitors (EC2) targeting external Public Endpoints (ThirdParty). In private customer environments, Private Monitors (EC2) test Private Targets (OnPremDC/Private systems) and send results securely back via AWS Global Accelerator to the Monitor API.
